verdict: INSUFFICIENT. Dark Souls is at zero across the whole repository and refs/souls-behaviour/ does not exist as a directory, so the entire A5 behavioural axis and the six reference items it serves (RI-CAM01, RI-CAM03, RI-CAM07, RI-WPN01-06, RI-AI02) still have no visual reference at all. Morrowind menus are at zero pixels (REF-A12 is 38 XML files); REF-A12b, REF-A20 and modern/ui were never created. Not one of the six refs/modern/ profile floors is met on count, on distinct games, or on the section-3 anti-curation rule, and interior_darkemissive has 8 files and 0 measurable ones. And the half of the set that reads PASS does not: all 89 Morrowind images are 320x320 square crops and cannot answer the questions their own slots ask.

fresh_findings.title: The Morrowind set is 89 square thumbnails and cannot answer the questions its own slots ask
fresh_findings.evidence: All 89 are 320x320 or 321x320 per MANIFEST.json script-computed width/height. REF-A13 asks for armour 'readable at close range', REF-A14 for weapons 'close enough to read the design language', REF-A15 for 'Daedric script signage' - none is answerable at 320px. A 1:1 crop of a 4:3 frame has also discarded the composition, so REF-A1 'exterior vista', REF-A8 'settlement density and layout' and REF-A19 'stilted waterside settlement' are judged from pictures that no longer contain their subject. One REF-A15 image is already in rejected/ for precisely this reason.
fresh_findings.why_missed: The folder reads PASS on count. There is no resolution or framing floor on refs/morrowind/ at all; section 4's 'no minimum resolution, and larger is not better there' is correct in spirit and has been read as licence for a square thumbnail. The missing rule is not resolution - it is 'full frame, native aspect, uncropped'.

fresh_findings.title: A5's richest artifact is a per-move animation library and it has a name
fresh_findings.evidence: darksouls.fandom.com Category:Dark Souls: Boss Attack Animations holds clips named by boss AND by individual move (Artorias - Heavy Slam, - Somersault Attack, - Overwhelming Leap, - Heavy Spin, - Heavy Thrust, - Wrath of the Abyss, - Spin Attack, - Abyss Sludge). RI-AI02's bar is legibility of one named move's windup silhouette; a per-move clip is the only artifact that isolates one.

fresh_findings.title: The fog gate and the arena are a designed object, and A5's six subfolders do not include them
fresh_findings.evidence: RI-AI06: 'The arena is part of the moveset... a space that has a size, a shape, and a small number of legible features' and 'the loop around the fight - fog gate in, die, run back, fog gate in - is a designed object with its own budget'. A5 lists camera/attacks/telegraph/stance/impact/ui-combat. Arena is not there and neither section 5a nor 5b has an arena or fog-gate slot.
fresh_findings.amendment: A5 gains a seventh subfolder, arena/

fresh_findings.title: Death and respawn presentation has no reference
fresh_findings.evidence: RI-JRN06's bar is visible events: 'control is taken for a bounded, skippable moment' and 'there is a bloodstain, visible from a distance, at the place they died - not at the nearest navmesh node, not floating in geometry'. Whether a bloodstain reads at distance is a composition-and-contrast question settleable only against an image of one. A5 has no death/ subfolder.

fresh_findings.title: Menu interaction, not static menu screens - Morrowind's real UI property is that windows are simultaneous
fresh_findings.evidence: A2 and REF-M22 both frame the ask as static single screens, which loses the property that matters: Morrowind's interface is a user-arranged, resizable, simultaneous tiling. REF-A12's MyGUI XML records 'map 300x300 pinnable' as an attribute and cannot show what a pinned layout looks like. RI-UIX06 A1 requires >=6 of nine materials 'across the full UI set' and A2 that 'no element is a plain rectangle' - both judge the assembled interface. Verified: Steam sid 3212740588 is one frame holding character sheet + paperdoll inventory + world map + magic window tiled by the player.
fresh_findings.amendment: A2's menu slots gain a multi-window requirement

fresh_findings.title: There is creature reference for Morrowind and for nothing else
fresh_findings.evidence: REF-A6 covers Morrowind creatures. Section 5a has no creature or enemy slot at all - REF-M6 is the player from behind. So the fidelity axis has zero reference for a non-humanoid enemy at combat distance, making RI-VIS08 section D (creature design vs creature quality seam) unjudgeable on the side that owns quality.

fresh_findings.title: No armour or weapon at readable scale on the modern side
fresh_findings.evidence: REF-A13/A14 cover Morrowind at 320px (see F1). Section 5a covers nothing: REF-M6 is a full-body rear view at 40-70% frame height, which does not resolve a pauldron joint, a scabbard mount or a cloth-to-metal transition. RI-CAM07 section B is 'the back-surface requirement' - the back of the armour 'gets more screen-time than any other surface in the game'. Not material_closeup either, which is one surface filling the frame.

fresh_findings.title: How a Souls level communicates a shortcut
fresh_findings.evidence: The visual grammar of a Souls shortcut - the one-way door seen from its wrong side, the kicked ladder, the lift reconnecting two known places - is a composition claim and nothing in the reference set is a composition.

fresh_findings.title: REF-M19 states a framing constraint no search query can express
fresh_findings.evidence: REF-M19 requires one frame containing both near water seen steeply from above and far water at a grazing angle, because RI-WLD10's metric compares those two regions inside a single frame. No searchText can express that. Same for section 5a's foreground-present/sky-visible and REF-M6's >=half rear-view ratio. Not a search problem - a triage-criterion problem. Every candidate list in this repo is ordered by Steam rating, a proxy for beauty, which is the exact bias section 3's anti-curation rule exists to defeat.

fresh_findings.title: NPC idle and conversation posture
fresh_findings.evidence: Morrowind's NPCs face the player rigidly with no conversation staging; that is a design-language property our transposition inherits or rejects deliberately.

fresh_findings.title: Weather as it actually appears is genuinely scarce, and should stop being BLOCKING
fresh_findings.evidence: The prior code critique established overcast returns 3-8 hits per game against ~50 for dramatic queries, and correctly called that a property of what people upload rather than a search failure.

dead_ends.dead_end: Morrowind app 22320 searchText='spellmaking' returns 0 results. Every other Morrowind menu query returns 5-15. Spellmaking must be found another way or classified SUBSTITUTABLE against the generic magic window.
darksouls.fandom.com /wiki/ URLs return HTTP 403 behind a Cloudflare interstitial. api.php returns 200 - use the MediaWiki API, not the HTML.

static.wikia.nocookie.net always transcodes to animated WebP. Verified three ways (Accept: image/gif, bare path, without /revision/latest) - all returned the identical 220,726-byte WebP against a stated 605,902-byte GIF. The true GIF bytes are NOT obtainable. Acceptable on the A5 axis only, where pixel_metrics_valid is false by rule; section-4-violating anywhere else.
searchText matches the uploader's TITLE, not the image - reconfirmed. DS3 searchText='fog gate' top hit sid 1914625699 is a dark cathedral exterior. Every candidate needs eyes before cataloguing.
/workshop/browse/?section=screenshots renders the mod workshop for any app that has one and returns zero screenshots, indistinguishable from 'no results'.
Steam rate-limits /sharedfiles/filedetails/ hard - 429s at 8 concurrent, returning a plausible-sized error page a naive cache will store.
HEAD on images.steamusercontent.com returns a bogus Content-Length: 92 for a sizeable minority of URLs. Use a ranged GET.
The bare ugc/<A>/<B>/ URL is the original; ?imw=5000 is an Akamai re-encode.
Skyrim SE's top-rated Steam gallery is ENB/mod-contaminated and titles do not disclose it (1.9% mention a mod).
RDR2 and Witcher 3 Steam galleries are photo-mode-heavy; section 5a bars photo-mode filters, DoF and vignette. Judge photo_mode per image, never assume false.
api.github.com unauthenticated returns 403 and there is no gh CLI in this container.
en.uesp.net returns 403 - its own bot protection. Use the vendored extract.
Steam store trailers are all cut montages; V1 and V2 both require 'no cuts'. The movies[] array in appdetails cannot serve refs/video/.
'overcast' returns 3-8 hits per game against ~50 for dramatic queries. Not a search failure to retry - a property of what people upload.

cheaper_route_found: The Steam LISTING page card already contains the bare ugc original URL - regex apphub_CardContentPreviewImage" src="..." and truncate at /?imw=.
